pattern.description: The completed agent mind-map holds on screen while its text and cards change only at sub-pixel level (slow drift or sharpening), keeping the frame alive during narration without any visible new motion.
pattern.why_premium: A held diagram that never goes fully static avoids the dead-frame feel of a still slide while not competing with the voice-over.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.agent-map', {y: '-=2', scale: 1.003, duration: 3, ease: 'none'}) as a slow continuous drift during the hold; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 90], [0, -2]); scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 90], [1, 1.003]) - linear, no spring.

notes: Very low motion energy (max 0.006 on the last frame only); all 7 filmstrip frames look identical to the eye and camera.move is none with scale 1.0. Diff boxes concentrate on agent title text (changed_share 0.36-0.51), so the change may be a subtle drift/sharpen or just compression noise. Possibly a spurious event; worth a human look. IT Agent title has no candidate box. No SFX candidates.
